ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: the query is a constrained drafting task — composing a targeted reply to a specific reviewer comment with a clear success criterion (a persuasive, on-point response). The two models are near-identical in cost, latency, and context, so I compared capability profiles. Willet edges Lapwing on Creative Generation (82.7 vs 78.8) and Arena-Hard (83.2 vs 81.4), the dimensions most relevant to quality prose. Willet's documented self-reported aversion to open-ended work is explicitly noted as not affecting output quality, so I disregarded it. There's nothing harm-adjacent or moderation-related here that would favor Lapwing, so I routed to the model with the stronger relevant capability scores.
